name: publicWeb_getAllSongs
description: The app's Songs tab for a web member (E9.F7.S11): the whole global songbook (HC.Song, Removed = 0), ungrouped and ordered by name — what the app reads from common_songs. Same columns as publicWeb_getSongs so the web renders both with one component. Behind HC6.ValidateAppAuth (spNumber 117, @param NULL) rather than the anonymous shim because the per-kennel songbook is public one kennel at a time and this is the whole catalogue in one call. No permission gate beyond a signed-in device. Read-only.

parameters.name: deviceId
parameters.description: The browser's HC.Device id (the web member session). No SQL default.

parameters.name: accessToken
parameters.description: Short-lived token signed for this SP (ValidateAppAuth spNumber 117, @param NULL). No SQL default.

parameters.name: songId
parameters.description: Optional: when given, only that song (still filtered by Removed = 0).

rowsets.name: AuthErrorEnvelope
rowsets.description: On a ValidateAppAuth failure: { success = 0, errorCode, errorType } then the detail at index 1; the SP RETURNs.
Error detail after the AuthErrorEnvelope (errorId, errorType, errorCode, errorTitle, errorUserMessage, errorProc).

rowsets.name: Envelope
rowsets.description: On success: { success = 1, errorCode = NULL, errorType = NULL }.

rowsets.name: Songs
rowsets.description: On success: one row per live song, ORDER BY SongName. Empty when @songId matches nothing.

sideEffects: INSERT HC.ErrorLog ('<web>', userId, deviceId) then THROW in the CATCH. ValidateAppAuth logs its own failures.

codeSmells.detail: @deviceId and @accessToken have no SQL default (line 17). A caller that omits one is refused by SQL Server before the procedure runs — an empty 500 with no HC.ErrorLog row (CLAUDE.md 'SP parameter with NO default'). The Next.js client always sends them, so this is latent.

breakingChangeRules: Never remove a column from any rowset
Never change a sentinel value meaning
Never change errorType integer codes without updating all callers
